title: Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer", at revision 1368435500, opens: "The Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer is a multilateral environmental agreement signed in 1985 that provided frameworks for international reductions in the production of chlorofluorocarbons due to their contribution to the destruction of the ozone layer, resulting in an increased threat of skin cancer." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q686455, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "environmental protocol". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
